preconditions.description: The number of destinations is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of corridors is between n - 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
Each destination is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No corridor connects a destination to itself.
The energy requirement for each corridor is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
It is possible to travel between any two destinations using zero or more corridors.

postconditions.description: The maximum energy E_max(c_1) for the first corridor c_1 is an integer.
The maximum energy E_max(c_1) for the first corridor c_1 is less than or equal to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: E_max(c_1) is the maximum energy such that the Daleks may still use the first corridor c_1 in their invasion
postconditions.description: The maximum energy E_max(c_1) is the largest energy such that the Daleks may still use the first corridor c_1 in their invasion.
